hints.title: Consecutive Function Difference
hints.text: Writing out F(k) and F(k-1) reveals a mathematical relationship. Every element coefficient increases by 1 except the wrapped element which drops to coefficient 0.

hints.title: Sum-Based Recurrence Relation
hints.text: Let S be the total sum of all elements in nums. Then F(k) = F(k-1) + S - n * nums[n - k].

hints.title: Single-Pass Recurrence Maximization
hints.text: Compute F(0) and the total sum in an initial pass. Iteratively apply the linear recurrence for k from 1 to n minus one, tracking the maximum value observed.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxRotateFunction(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        total_sum = sum(nums)
        cur_f = sum(i * x for i, x in enumerate(nums))
        max_f = cur_f
        for k in range(1, n):
            cur_f = cur_f + total_sum - n * nums[n - k]
            max_f = max(max_f, cur_f)
        return max_f
```

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating F(k) independently for each k takes O(N) per rotation, leading to quadratic O(N^2) total time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: The mathematical recurrence calculates each successive rotation in O(1) time using O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the delta F(k) - F(k-1) = sum - n * nums[n - k] algebraically.
